showListing.text: Events FAQ About Contact Sign in Alex Example Don't Be So Hard on Yourself About the Show "Don't Be So Hard on Yourself" is a cabaret concert of new songs written by Alex Example (featuring guest songwriters Jo Marchetti and Teddy Rowe) built around a simple but resonant idea: that we are often our own harshest critics, and that there is real power, and real humor, in learning to sing those harsh words and let them go. Example and a cast of stunning friends each bring their own voice and perspective to the intimate, funny, cathartic material. It's an hour spent in the company of people who are all figuring it out together. Featuring: Cole Bradenton Capri Castellane Jo Marchetti Jamila Sabare Teddy Rowe Genre New Artists Duration 75 minutes Age Restriction All ages 570 Example Avenue New York, NY 10036 View on map Show Disclaimer/Terms All Sales are Final. draft.subject: Photographing Alex Example's Don't Be So Hard on Yourself at The Example Room
draft.body: My name is Dan and I'm a professional arts photographer here in NYC. I'm writing in regard to your August 3 show at The Example Room. I shoot documentary coverage without flash, staying out of the way, so the performance isn't disturbed and the audience doesn't notice anyone working. I've photographed at Carnegie Hall for nearly ten years, along with work at Lincoln Center and Radio City Music Hall, and you can see my portfolio at danwrightphotography.com. If you don't have someone on it already, I'd be glad to talk about your photography plans for the night. I look forward to hearing from you!
